missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сущность' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative case, acting as the subject. 'Проблемы' is a genitive specifying which essence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Сущность' is the direct object of 'понять'. For feminine soft-sign nouns the accusative equals the nominative, so the form is unchanged.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Сущности' is the genitive form after 'без'. Feminine soft-sign nouns take -и in the genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Сущности' is genitive because the negated 'нет' requires the genitive. 'Глубокой' agrees in the feminine genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Сущности' is the dative form governed by 'посвятить'. Feminine soft-sign nouns share the -и ending in the dative singular.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Сущностью' is the instrumental form governed by 'овладеть'. Feminine soft-sign nouns end in -ью in the instrumental singular.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Сущности' is the prepositional form after 'в', naming the topic. Feminine soft-sign nouns take -и in the prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Сущность' is nominative as the subject of the clause. 'Истинная' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Сущности' is the plural accusative direct object of 'сравнивают'. For inanimate feminine nouns the plural accusative equals the nominative plural in -и.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Сущность' is nominative as the subject of 'остаётся'. 'Главная' agrees in feminine, and 'неизменной' is an instrumental predicate.
